column1: # title: ACMG SF v3.3 list for reporting of secondary findings in clinical exome and genome sequencing (Genet Med 2025;27(8):101454, doi:10.1016/j.gim.2025.101454), Table 1
# transcribed: 2026-10-18; gene set cross-checked against NCBI ClinVar's ACMG SF v3.2 page (81 genes) plus the three v3.3 additions ABCD1, CYP27A1, PLN
# inheritance: as printed in Table 1, except LDLR, printed "SD" (semidominant), recorded as AD because heterozygotes are affected
# report: Table 1's "variants to report" column and its footnotes, transcribed 2026-10-30, one rule per gene:
#   all: "All P and LP"; for GLA and OTC "All hemi, het, homozygous P and LP" (footnote a: heterozygous females too).
#     LMNA's footnote e (missense never associated with cardiac disease is not reported) is the classifier's call, not a rule here.
#   biallelic: "P and LP (2 variants)" (MUTYH, CASQ2, TRDN, BTD, CYP27A1, GAA, RPE65, ATP7B; footnote a: two P/LP
#     variants "even when phase is undetermined"); for ABCD1 "All hemi, homozygous or two het. P and/or LP" (footnote k:
#     a single heterozygous variant is not reported).
#   truncating: TTN, footnote f: "Only truncating variants in the Titin gene (TTN tv) should be reported".
#     Truncating is ClinVar's molecular consequence nonsense, frameshift, splice donor or splice acceptor (TTN tv as usually defined).
#   homozygous:<vid>: HFE, "HFE p.C282Y homozygotes only" (footnote j: NM_000410.3, c.845G>A, ClinVar variation 9), its GRCh38 vid.
